Find and defeat [[the Great Destroyer]] to halt the [[Destroyer]]s' attacks on the [[Dwarf|Dwarven]] forces.  

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
* All party members must have completed [[Destruction's Depths]].
===Objectives===
* Defeat the Great Destroyer.

===Reward===
* [[Deldrimor rank|Dwarf reputation points]]
** First time: 5,000 (7,500 in hard mode)
** On repeat: 100 (150 in hard mode)
* 2,500 [[Experience]]

==Walkthrough==
===Great Destroyer===

A successful method to complete this quest is to stay on the shore while killing the three [[Destroyer of Lives]] in the three pools nearby the entrance, then have everyone move back to the shore. Wait there until the Great Destroyer uses Lava Ground enough to dry the lava pool where the furthest Destroyer of Lives was (a player will need to move to the closest pool to trigger the Great Destroyer's skills). Once the pool dries have everyone run up to the pool and fight there. 

* Searing Breath can deal major damage to low-armor rating party members. To prevent this, have a member with higher armor rating engage the Great Destroyer and turn him so he is facing away from the rest of the party. This way only one member is affected by this skill. 
* Be careful when bringing interrupts due to Enraged Blast's. Call of Destruction and Lava Ground are worth interrupting due to the damage you can suffer by not doing so. Enraged Blast has a quick cast time and is actually interruptable too, but interrupting Enraged Blast will result in another Enraged Blast.

Aggravate the Great Destroyer so he will attack your party on this plate. If it uses Lava Wave turn your attention temporarily to other Destroyers until it rises back up. Continue until the Great Destroyer is defeated.

=== Skill recommendations ===
* [[Pain Inverter]], if effectively used, will do massive damage, causing the great Destroyer to lose half or more health in one shot. Bring [[spirit]]s and summoned allies to increase the number of targets. Interrupting the Great Destroyer is actually a good idea in this case, as Enraged Blast will also backfire. 
* Destroyer of Lives, Lava Wave and Searing Breath inflict fire damage, so consider bringing [[skill]]s that [[Fire damage#Skills that protect against fire damage|protect against fire damage]] or [[Elemental damage#Skills that protect against elemental damage|elemental damage]] 
* Your party will be in [[lava]] that inflicts [[Burning]] throughout the quest. Consider bringing [[Frigid Armor]], [[Extinguish]], and/or [[Breath of the Great Dwarf]]. 
* Bring [[Party healing|party heals]]. 
* Having skills to prevent [[knock down]]s (e.g. [[Ward of Stability]] or [[Fleeting Stability]]) may be useful to prevent knock downs from Lava Blast and Enraged Blast at inopportune moments.
* [[Alkar's Alchemical Acid]] is useful against all the foes in this mission.
* Life stealing by [[touch ranger]]s (and others) will bypass Lava Wave.
* When fighting the Great Destroyer, speed can be important due to the fairly constant damage and [[health degeneration]].
* Regarding interrupts :
** Lava Ground will eventually make the entire area unsafe to stand in; [[interrupt]] this if you are able.
** All of the Great Destroyer skills are [[Skill (skill type)|untyped skills]], so only skills that interrupt [[action]]s or skills will interrupt its skills and trigger Enraged Blast. 
*** A hero with skills that only interrupt [[spell]]s can be useful against the Destroyer [[spellcaster]]s and prevent the hero from interrupting the Great Destroyer and triggering Enraged Blast.
** [[Confusing Images]] and [[Migraine]] can cause the Great Destroyer to activate skills slower, which will lower the Great Destroyer's [[damage per second]] and make it easier to continuously interrupt Enraged Blast.
* [[55 Monk]]s are extremely effective here as long as no [[Destroyer of Deeds]] spawn as they will cause mass interruption.
* [[Disable|Disabling]] (or even simply interrupting) [[Lava Wave]] can prevent the Great Destroyer from healing itself.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
:''"In every age there are heroes and villains, victors and vanquisher, saviors and destroyers. You stand today at a precipice between the past and the future, facing a choice with effects that will ripple throughout time. Become the stuff of legends, or one of history's forgotten. May the future hold a world where your exploits this day are told as an inspirational tale of courage, persistence and hope. Go now. Meet the Great Destroyer, and may the gods smile on us all."''

===Intermediate dialogue===
;High Priest Alkar
:''"Long have I studied the [[Tome of Rubicon]] and the lore of the Great Destroyer.  Never did I expect to see the Great Destroyer surface in my lifetime."''
:'''Continue:''' ''We plan to strike the Great Destroyer head on.''
:''"Without the power of the Great Dwarf, your attack has little chance of success.  However, given the size of your party, you may be able to slip through.  Will you continue with this plan?"''
:'''Accept:''' ''The Great Destroyer must be stopped. There is no other way.''
:'''Decline:''' ''I should reconsider my options.''

;First time using Lava Ground
:'''Party member:''' ''"Everyone, keep to the hardened lava or you'll [[Burning|burn]] to death!"''

;First time using Lava Wave
:'''Party member:''' ''"We can't hurt him while he is defensive. Kill his minions!"''

;First time interrupted
:'''Party member:''' ''"Interrupts [[Enraged Blast|enrage]] him! Use them wisely."''

== Notes ==
* On completion of [[Destruction's Depths]] for the first time on a [[character]], A Time for Heroes will be added to your [[Quest Log]] automatically. 
* After completing this quest, your party will be taken to [[Epilogue]].
* This quest (and all [[List of Eye of the North primary quests|primary repeatable Eye of the North quests]]) may also be obtained from the [[Scrying Pool]] in the [[Hall of Monuments]] after completing it once.
* Completion of this mission will fill in page #16 of the [[Hero's Handbook]] [[storybook]].
* Unlike previous campaigns where missions are contained in outposts with visually distinct map icons and can be started from an NPC with a rotating green icon, the way in which this quest can be started is by going to [[Central Transfer Chamber]] and talking to [[High Priest Alkar]] which is marked in game with a green, rotating, shield-like icon, akin to the one of Mission NPCs.

{{anomaly|The lava in this mission does not cause the Crippled condition.}}

{{bug| While A Time for Heroes is in your quest log, you will keep receiving an announcement each time you go the [[Central Transfer Chamber]], "Quest Added: A Time For Heroes". This continues until you complete the quest.}}
